title: Data, code and analysis for: One student at a time: large language models do not grade students independently when they share a context
description:
Tasks and grading criteria, 720 AI-generated student texts in German as a foreign language with their intended grades, expert ratings, every model request and answer (two local and two commercial large language models; alone, batch and chat grading workflows), the experiment runners, and the Jupyter notebook that produces all figures and tables of the paper.

Data (assignments.json, texts/, ratings/, results/) are licensed under CC BY 4.0; code (*.py, *.sh, analysis.ipynb) under the MIT License.
